notes.title: Translations on Mobile, Plushie Update, Name commissions open & more!
notes.content:
The mobile version now has Chinese, French, Romanian, Spanish, Russian, Japanese, and Portuguese translations!

We are working on the Micah Yujin Makeship Plushie!

The beta-build is out! (On Patreon and Ko-Fi!)

Name commissions are open if you’d like your name to be voiced!

On Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/posts/error143-name-87351322

On Ko-fi: https://ko-fi.com/jennyvipham/commissions#buyShopCommissionModal

[u]Update[/u]
I’ve caught up to most things that I need to do! Just waiting on art assets and the extra voice lines and then the second part of day 5 should be ready to go! Love you lots!
